messages:
Mia Chen: Heads-up on Redwood -> Beacon renewal. Procurement asked if we can convert a 12% concession into an "onboarding services" credit applied to the invoice. They say adoption lag is the real problem.
Diego Ramos: Adoption notes: SSO mapping still failing intermittently, CSV bulk-import not available, only ~40% of users completed training.
Lena Ortiz: Can we offer 10 service hours + 2 enablement sessions (max 12 seats) as a credit? They want it reflected on the renewal invoice, not as a separate invoice.
AJ Patel: Finance: we can do invoice credit if we have a clear Delivery & Acceptance milestone and the credit is non-refundable. Also need a clause to avoid revenue deferral (either term extension or minimum committed spend).
Mia Chen: Customer asked for a 6-month extension if we can't deliver the CSV import within 3 weeks. Product, can you confirm ETA? /cc @Samir
Samir Khatri: Product: L0 scoping says CSV import is ~2 weeks dev + 3 days QA. If we start immediately we can ship before renewal.
Diego Ramos: That would fix 70% of provisioning issues. Procurement will accept services credit if CSV ship date is firm.
Lena Ortiz: For operational safety, require PO number on renewal invoice and signed acceptance checklist before applying credit. ops-bot: confirm flow.
ops-bot: Confirmed. We require PO matching invoice line, completed acceptance checklist, and trainer deliverables (recording + attendee list) before credit is applied.
AJ Patel: Legal: any recorded sessions or demoing customer data needs explicit consent. @legal-bot please prepare a one-paragraph addendum "Training Recording & Data Use".
legal-bot: Will draft addendum and a short "Services Credit Acceptance" clause (recordings, data, consent). ETA 5 hours.
Mia Chen: Draft amendment language I plan to send to procurement:
`Customer will receive a one-time invoice credit equal to up to 10 hours of professional services and two enablement sessions (up to 12 seats). Credit applied upon delivery and Customer acceptance of services (training recording, attendee list, signed acceptance checklist) and conditioned on PO match. Credit is non-transferable and non-refundable.`
Samir Khatri: Add line: "If CSV import delivery is delayed beyond X date, the parties agree to a 3-month prorate credit instead" to reduce churn risk.
AJ Patel: I'll run two scenarios in $: (A) credit + CSV shipped vs (B) 3-month prorate + extension. Sharing numbers by EOD.
Mia Chen: I'll hold procurement counter until legal & finance approve amendment wording. Diego, can you push procurement to confirm which path they prefer if product misses the date?
Diego Ramos: Will ping them now. They prefer the CSV + credit route but want contingency plan if dates slip.
Mia Chen: Thanks — once legal drafts addendum and finance confirms, I'll send amendment + addendum for countersignature. :thumbsup:
